rust_summary: an advancement's display: title, description, frame, chat announcement and hidden flag (`native_advancement_display`).
doc_summary: `native_advancement_display(id)` returns the `AdvancementDisplay` of an advancement in the loaded tree: `title` and `description` as text, `frame` as `task`, `goal` or `challenge`, `announce_to_chat` and `hidden`; None for an unknown id or one without a display. API @API:advancement_display@.
